value.residual: Lean proves exact replay is state-preserving, conflicting replay rejects, and a stored receipt blocks a second abstract commit. Retained InMemory receipts bind both the semantic input hash and a canonical authority-effect digest; request-local correlation IDs are normalized out while deterministic action/ledger IDs make lost-reply reconstruction stable. Turso-persisted receipt and reopen evidence was removed in #2764 (not currently covered). The correspondence is not machine-proved, pre-v3 receipts fail closed on replay, and legacy unversioned callers remain. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code.
